source_research: Catalogue-wide GST rate candidates using the 7 November 2026 audited 1,159-SKU catalogue snapshot and Souviks' explicit 18% default instruction
catalogue_status_basis: All catalogue records; 18% is the default candidate unless the exact product qualifies for a specific notified exception
exception_rule: Specified tractor brake assemblies/parts may be 5% only where the exact notified goods description and tractor-use condition are met; otherwise default candidate is 18%

references.latest_amendment: Notification No. 02/2026-Central Tax (Rate), G.S.R. 921(E), 27 October 2026, effective 1 November 2026

note: This field is a GST rate candidate based on explicit business direction, not accountant-approved final tax setup. Existing HSN fields/evidence are not rewritten. No gst_rate_percent final field is set. Every product remains invoice_ready=false and accountant_approval_required=true.
